title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: policy tuning analysis for priority content-only policies
notes: claim 52: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the policy creation path omits the required category and template choices. The notice already says the insights concern activity containing the selected priority content, contrary to the open question. Claims about guaranteed alerts and unchanged behaviour also go beyond the evidence.

claims.claim: Policy tuning analysis predicts in real time how many tenant users could match policy conditions.
claims.quote: Policy tuning analysis provides admins with a real-time prediction of the number of users in a tenant that could potentially match a given set of policy conditions.

claims.claim: This update extends policy tuning analysis to policies scoped for priority content.
claims.quote: With this update, policy tuning analysis will support insider risk policies that are scoped for priority content.

claims.claim: The priority-content scoring choice assigns scores and generates alerts for specified activities containing priority content.
claims.quote: Risk scores are assigned and alerts are generated only when specified activities include priority content. Activities without priority content aren't scored, but you can still review them if an alert is generated.

claims.claim: The notice instructs admins to enable Analytics, create or edit an all-user policy, select priority content and choose the priority-content-only scoring option.
claims.quote: Create/edit a policy scoped to all users in the organization. ... On the scoring page, select Get alerts only for activity that includes priority content:

claims.claim: One to two days after saving the policy, editing it shows per-indicator insights under Choose your own thresholds.
claims.quote: 1-2 days after the policy is saved, edit the policy again and navigate to the indicator thresholds page where insights on user activity containing the scoped priority content for each indicator will be visible under Choose your own thresholds:

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature does not change policies by itself, so doing nothing preserves current policy behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management policy tuning real-time analytics automatically change thresholds notify users'; read notice, analytics, configure and indicator-threshold sections. They describe admin configuration but do not expressly guarantee unchanged policy behaviour.
claims.fix: Replace the autonomy bullet with 'Admins can adjust indicator thresholds and see the insight update in real time.' In Why it matters, remove 'so a tenant that does nothing keeps its current policy behaviour'. In the risk rationale, replace 'so nothing reaches users or data until an admin opts in' with 'and using the estimates requires Analytics to be enabled'.

claims.claim: End users are not notified or changed by this feature.

claims.fix: Remove 'end users are not notified or changed by this feature' from the impact rationale. Retain the rationale that the estimates are for Insider Risk Management admins and policy authors.
